name: 02-dashboard
prompt:
Use case: text-localization. Image 1 is the edit target, an already localized Russian App Store poster. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for the normal-width rounded heavy headline typeface.
Make ONE targeted correction to the TOP MARKETING TYPOGRAPHY ONLY. Current Russian lettering is excessively condensed/narrow and looks squeezed. Replace it with the same NORMAL-WIDTH heavy rounded geometric sans-serif proportions as image 2; NOT condensed, no horizontal compression. Use line breaks rather than squeezed letters.
Preserve every pixel/compositional detail BELOW THE PHONE TOP, including phone size/position, all correct Russian UI, colors, cards, tabs, badges. Leave phone exactly where it is. Keep background and ribbons unchanged. Fit corrected heading and subtitle in existing top area by modestly reducing overall font size, NOT letter width. Do not overlap phone. Clear optical spacing, 4% side margins. All exact approved wording must remain, no final periods.

Top headline in THREE centered lines:
"Больше баланса" — teal
"Меньше экранного" — navy
"времени" — navy
Use a consistent normal-width heavy rounded typeface. The navy lines form one phrase.
Below it, smaller subtitle in TWO lines:
"Помогайте ребёнку пользоваться"
"телефоном осознанно"
Fit all text ABOVE unchanged phone top at ~18.5% canvas height. Three headline lines occupy ~12.5% canvas height together; subtitle ~3.5%, with breathing space. Preserve exact badge "Лимиты, которые подходят для вашей семьи". No UI changes. Portrait 1206:2622.
